user.title: Scene Studio
user.description: Adds Scene Studio to the sidebar. Create and edit rooms from there — one integration, as many areas as you need. Daylight that follows the sun between your scenes.

empty.extrapolation: No circadian scenes yet. Create one to start lighting a room from the sun.
empty.extrapolation_body: Scene Studio blends your room’s lights between solar events — dawn, sunrise, noon, sunset, and dusk — so brightness and color follow the day.
empty.extrapolation_example: Create a scene for a room from an area, or auto configure all areas that have lights.
empty.auto_configure_body: Auto configure creates a circadian scene for every area that has lights, using the default circadian preset. You can edit color presets and circadian presets here anytime — lights update the next time a scene runs.
empty.area_no_scenes: No scenes yet — create one for this area
empty.select_scene: Select a scene to get started
empty.select_scene_body: Choose a scene from the list to edit its lights through the day, or add a scene from an area.
empty.no_areas: No Home Assistant areas yet. Add floors and areas in Settings, then come back.

library.title: Presets
library.hint: Changing a color preset or circadian preset updates scenes that still use it. Lights change on the next activate or automatic update — not instantly.
library.variable_edit_hint: Color and brightness are shared by every circadian preset or light that still uses this color preset.
library.palette_edit_hint: A scene preset is five colors. Lights that use it pick a slot; changing the preset updates those lights the next time a scene runs.
library.theme_hint: Open a circadian preset to edit its color and brightness at each solar event. Changes apply to every circadian scene that still uses the preset; per-light overrides stay as they are.
library.theme_edit_hint: Editing {name} changes every circadian scene that still uses this circadian preset. Per-light overrides on those scenes stay as they are.
library.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {name}?

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These settings apply to every room. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.automatically_update_lights_on_helper: After you activate a scene, lights keep adjusting on the interval from Settings so the room follows the sun. Tap to turn this off for every room.
settings.automatically_update_lights_off_helper: Automatic updates are off. Activating a scene applies lights once. Tap to turn updates back on for every room.
settings.automatically_update_lights_interval_hel: After a scene is activated, keep updating the lights this often with the same transition length (target = how the room should look at the end of the transition). 0 turns automatic updates off for every room — same as the control at the top of the list.
settings.dusk_minimum_time_of_day_helper: To avoid lights dimming too much, too early. Applies to every circadian scene and circadian preset.
settings.reset_confirm: This deletes every Scene Studio scene and its Home Assistant scene. Scene presets, color presets, and circadian presets are replaced with the five default colors and the Default circadian preset, and settings return to their defaults. Lights, areas, and other integrations stay. This cannot be undone.
